mapper.select: SELECT mv.member_allot_store AS stationCode, mv.member_allot_stationName AS stationName, COUNT(*) AS memberCount FROM member_info_view mv WHERE mv.del_flag = '0' AND mv.member_allot_store IS NOT NULL AND mv.member_allot_stationName IS NOT NULL AND (mv.member_allot_stationName = #{keyword} OR mv.member_allot_stationName = CONCAT(#{keyword}, '店')) GROUP BY mv.member_allot_store, mv.member_allot_stationName ORDER BY memberCount DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT mv.member_allot_store AS stationCode, mv.member_allot_stationName AS stationName, COUNT(*) AS memberCount FROM member_info_view mv WHERE mv.del_flag = '0' AND mv.member_allot_store IS NOT NULL AND mv.member_allot_stationName IS NOT NULL AND mv.member_allot_stationName LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY mv.member_allot_store, mv.member_allot_stationName ORDER BY memberCount DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT mv.member_allot_store AS stationCode, mv.member_allot_stationName AS stationName, COUNT(*) AS memberCount FROM member_info_view mv WHERE mv.del_flag = '0' AND mv.member_allot_store IS NOT NULL AND mv.member_allot_stationName IS NOT NULL AND mv.member_allot_stationName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY mv.member_allot_store, mv.member_allot_stationName ORDER BY memberCount DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT mv.member_mobile AS memberMobile, mv.member_name AS memberName, mv.member_allot_store AS stationCode, mv.member_allot_stationName AS stationName FROM member_info_view mv WHERE mv.del_flag = '0' AND mv.member_mobile IS NOT NULL AND mv.member_mobile LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY mv.member_created DESC LIMIT 20
